newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTONIA-ASA MAJOR SHAREHOLDER SELLS SHARES.
newsitem.headline: ESTONIA-ASA MAJOR SHAREHOLDER SELLS SHARES.

text.p: ASA Insurance major shareholder Wellfix Investment Ltd sold 475,000 shares to Estonian investors on Friday, Hansa Investments said.
The minimum price of the shares was set at 67 kroons and the highest offered price was 80 kroons, deputy director Viktor Mahhov said in a statement.
Wellfix Investment sold some of its stake to increase the number of shares in public hands and to test the price of shares before the public offering, due to start in July.
ASA Insurance will increase its present share capital of 25.4 million kroons to 28.9 million kroons.
Hansa Investments will continue the closed share offering during the next two weeks to foreign investors in London and Scandinavia.
ASA share holders have also approved a listing of the company's shares on the Tallinn bourse.
